listing.name: Dynasty Warriors 2 — pc-dynastywarriors2 (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: This is the first game using ps2kit’s own recompiler and runtime. The extent of working gameplay is unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL SLES50057 disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the local analysis, recompilation and build instructions. The original IOP sound modules still run through an interpreter.

warnings: This is the first game using ps2kit’s own recompiler and runtime. The extent of working gameplay is unknown.
